findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Four cans of Campbell’s Chunky Chili were observed with dents along the top, and one can had a dent on the side seam at the top of the can. All four cans were removed from the sales floor to be wasted. 
 Food packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the food is not exposed to adulteration or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12  - Disposable paper towels not provided at the hand washing sink. Provide disposable paper towels at hand washing sinks. 

Paper towels were not dispensing in the restrooms. Issue was immediately resolved. Paper towels were incorrectly stocked in the dispensers when replaced. Paper towel rolls were stocked to allow proper dispensing.
Management was advised to train all staff on proper stocking of paper towel dispensers and to verify towels are dispensing properly upon stocking.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 (A) - Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Floors in the following areas were observed to be soiled:
A) in the mop closet (general buildup around the mop sink);  and
B) under metal stationary shelves in the stock room behind the walkin cooler/freezer (plastic/general debris). 
Clean the floors in the aforementioned areas as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
